name: Doshan
description: Doshan was an Expansion Region world situated in the Drannik sector. It was the homeworld of Doshan blood worms. A raider from Doshan once injured Galactic Republic Chief Sergeant Saens Sukko during a mission to collapse the Clowse Glowstack structure as part of the Waymancy Storm conflict. Later, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, a group of Trandoshans attacked Imperial colonists on Doshan. In response, the Empire's 501st Legion carried out an operation on the world, including an attack against a Trandoshan nest near the Arakka waterway. Doshan eventually became a member of the New Republic.
